results.title: Saurabh Mukherjea's 50:50 rule for Nifty and S&P 500
results.description: The Indian market has seldom been the top asset over the last ten years, says Saurabh Mukherjea, Founder & CIO, Marcellus Investment Managers, at the ET Wealth Expo in Mumbai. His Markowitz-based fix: put 50% in the Nifty and 50% in the S&P 500, and rebalance once a year. You get returns near the stronger market and volatility near the calmer one, with no forecasting needed.
